segments.gist: A mighty angel casts a millstone into the sea, symbolizing Babylon's violent and final fall, and declares that her music, crafts, and light will be no more.

19.summary: Heaven erupts in praise over God's judgment on Babylon, and the marriage of the Lamb is announced. Christ appears as a rider on a white horse to judge and make war, defeating the beast and the false prophet, who are cast into the lake of fire.

segments.title: Heaven Praises God's Judgment
segments.gist: A great multitude in heaven praises God for judging Babylon and announces the marriage of the Lamb.

segments.title: Christ on White Horse
segments.gist: Heaven opens and Christ rides out as a faithful and true warrior, judging and making war in righteousness.

segments.title: Angel Calls Birds to Feast
segments.gist: An angel calls the birds of the air to gather for the great supper of God on the flesh of kings and armies.

segments.title: Beast and False Prophet Defeated
segments.gist: The beast and the kings of the earth gather to make war, but the beast and false prophet are captured and cast into the lake of fire.

20.summary: Satan is bound for a thousand years while Christ reigns with resurrected martyrs; after being released, he deceives the nations and is cast into the lake of fire. The dead are then judged before a great white throne, and death and hell are cast into the lake of fire, with anyone not found in the book of life also cast in.

segments.title: Satan Bound for a Thousand Years
segments.gist: An angel binds Satan and casts him into the bottomless pit for a thousand years.

segments.title: Martyrs Reign with Christ
segments.gist: John sees thrones and the souls of martyrs who reign with Christ for a thousand years in the first resurrection.

segments.title: Satan Loosed and Defeated
segments.gist: After a thousand years, Satan is released, deceives the nations, and is cast into the lake of fire.

segments.title: Great White Throne Judgment
segments.gist: The dead are judged before a great white throne, and death, hell, and the unsaved are cast into the lake of fire.

21.summary: John sees a new heaven and a new earth, with the holy city New Jerusalem descending from God. A loud voice declares God's dwelling with humanity, and God promises to wipe away every tear. An angel shows John the city's wall, gates, and foundations, and its measurements; the city has no temple because God and the Lamb are its temple, and no need of sun or moon because the glory of God lights it. Only those written in the Lamb's book of life enter.

segments.title: New Heaven and New Earth
segments.gist: John sees a new heaven and earth, the holy city descending, and hears God promise to dwell with humanity and wipe away tears.

segments.title: The Bride, the Lamb's Wife
segments.gist: An angel shows John the holy city Jerusalem descending, with twelve gates bearing the names of Israel's tribes and twelve foundations with the Lamb's apostles.

segments.title: Measuring the City
segments.gist: The angel measures the city with a golden reed; it is foursquare, its wall jasper, its foundations adorned with precious stones, and its gates pearls.

segments.title: God and the Lamb Are the Temple
segments.gist: The city has no temple, for God and the Lamb are its temple; it needs no sun or moon, for God's glory lights it, and only those written in the Lamb's book enter.

22.summary: John sees the river of water of life and the tree of life in the New Jerusalem, where God's servants will reign forever. Christ declares His imminent return, and John closes the book with warnings and a final invitation and benediction.

segments.title: River and Tree of Life
segments.gist: John describes the pure river of water of life and the tree of life bearing monthly fruit, with no more curse and God's servants seeing His face.

segments.title: Angel Affirms Prophecy
segments.gist: The angel affirms the words are faithful and true, and John is told not to seal the prophecy but to let the unjust and righteous remain as they are.

segments.title: Christ's Promise and Invitation
segments.gist: Jesus declares He is coming quickly with His reward, identifies Himself as Alpha and Omega, and the Spirit and bride invite all who thirst to come.

segments.title: Warning and Final Benediction
segments.gist: John warns against adding to or taking away from the prophecy, and closes with the promise of Christ's coming and a benediction of grace.
